approaches.name: integrated tax data warehouse with GIS property mapping
approaches.description: The project links tax authority databases through a shared data warehouse, digitizes and geo-maps property tax records, and extends NFMIS to municipal administrations. Practices: geo-tagged asset maps of government real estate for revenue; TA-supported big data analytics in tax administration; digitization of urban immovable property tax records and valuations; NFMIS used by TMAs to record payments; linked taxpayer database queried by CNIC/name across tax authorities; GIS-generated reports for digitized urban property tax records; shared data warehouse linking KP tax authorities and third parties; automated taxpayer data exchange via shared data warehouse by CNIC/STN; GIS-mapped property records with MIS for UIPT valuation; data warehouse integrating datasets of three tax authorities; GIS-mapped digitization of urban immovable property tax records; Extension of NFMIS financial management system to TMAs; Electronic archival and document management system for pilot departments.
